content: चर्चित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Anointed, smeared, perfumed, scented <ab>&c.</ab>; चन्दनचर्चितनीलकलेवरपीतवसनवनमाली <ls>Gīt.</ls> I; <ls>Ṛs. 2. 21</ls>. .²2 Discussed, considered, investigated. .²3 Sought, desired; Repeated in reciting the veda while इति is added. .{@-तम्@} Anointing, smearing.
